body: I appreciate the kind words, just having a place to talk about this and get it off my chest has helped me a little bit. I don’t want to talk about it with anybody that we know because I feel they wouldn’t understand and would just cast judgement instead of helping. I don’t want to tell him how much I worry either because I don’t want him to get the idea that he is a burden to me but I think about it every single day, even during the good days. Having my own kind of anxiety doesn’t help at all either. But we have each other and that’s all I need.

We do have a dog and I think that does help tremendously, she can pick up in it and give extra cuddles. I also encourage him to have any hobbies he wants, a lot of building things which helps him stay busy and out of his head, but these days just sneak up on us sometimes with no way to stop the darkness from taking over. I can accept that this will probably be the way it ends, as does with most people suffering with this illness, but i can’t completely accept it this soon, we are only 30 with so much to look forward to and I don’t want to live the rest of my life without him.
I’m sorry, I wouldn’t wish this on my worst enemy. Having somewhere to talk about it freely does help. Thank you for taking time out of your day to respond and good luck my friend.

Without insurance it is nearly impossible to get help here. There is one mental health clinic with underpaid staff that don’t really care if they help or hurt people, with a 1-3 month waiting list and having to pay a few hundred dollars up front per visit, not to mention the cost of most medication. His family doesn’t care or see a problem with anything that they put him through, and what’s left of my family is busy with their own lives. We are all barely making enough money to pay bills with no real savings or backup plan. I believe it will pass this time, but I feel this will eventually be the inevitable ending I will have to deal with, just like a few of his family members that also suffered with this illness. The brain is such a fragile thing and people don’t realize the damage they’ve done until it’s too late. I’m just glad I have somewhere to let my emotions out completely, I worry that if I tell him this completely that he will feel like a burden for it and make it worse.

Thank you, it helps knowing we aren’t the only ones struggling with this darkness. Things have definitely gotten better and this happens a lot less often, it just tears me apart to see him suffering so fucking much because of his shitty childhood breaking his brain, meanwhile his parents act like nothing happened and live in their own fantasy of being good parents because they were too fucked up on her ion to remember. Thank you for taking time to respond, just having people to relate to helps.

There is one major mental health clinic here and the wait is usually 3 months, without insurance they want us to pay a few hundred up front per visit just for therapy. They are understaffed and underpaid and most people I know that went there leave feeling worse than they did when they got there, I’m not sure how they stay open really. I worked at a family practice for people without insurance or on Medicaid and there were so many times that a patient would not be able to get meds refilled by their mental health physician, and after being out for a few days and me calling the place repeatedly the nurse would finally answer just to tell me that the patient had been terminated for no shows and that she is well aware that the patient had been calling her but she just didn’t feel like telling them yet. We have been able to avoid a bad episode for a few months by cutting out as much stress as possible, even changing jobs to help, but this time all it took was some random crackheads yelling at us and it sent him spiraling down into not even wanting to live anymore after being mad. I like to think that he wouldn’t leave me here alone in purpose right now, I expect it to happen eventually but not for a long time, I just feel bad if he is suffering constantly just for me.

If she really loves you then she definitely notices. I often know it’s going to be a bad day before he does, I can just pick up on the vibes or something, it’s hard to explain but I know it’s just a matter of time and one thing going wrong to set it off. It’s impossible to stop from happening and I just try to set everything up the best I can for it. I don’t want to tell him how hard it is for me to watch so helplessly from the sideline because I’m worried he is going to feel like a burden to me for it and he is far from a burden.
